name: White Matter Anatomy Segmentation Plus (wmaSeg++)
summary: Segments major white matter tracts from a whole-brain tractogram with wmaSeg++, a fast Python port of the wma_tools anatomical segmentation (Bullock et al. 2019) using the FreeSurfer Destrieux parcellation.
description: Converts the FreeSurfer aparc.a2009s+aseg to NIfTI, then applies anatomically defined ROI, planar and endpoint criteria (ported from the MATLAB wma_tools) in parallel to classify streamlines into named bundles such as the arcuate, IFOF, ILF, MdLF, VOF, cingulum, CST and callosal tracts, and builds VTK surfaces for visualisation. Use it for atlas-free anatomical tract segmentation without a MATLAB runtime. The tractogram and FreeSurfer directory must be from the same subject and in the same space; needs a FreeSurfer license.

outputs.description: White matter tract classification: classification.mat, per-tract JSON files, and VTK surfaces.
Per-bundle TCK files (one per named tract), as alternative to WMC. Only produced when save_tck is enabled.

parameters.description: Save per-tract TCK files to tracts_tck/ (alternative to WMC)

citations.text: Bullock D, Takemura H, Caiafa CF, et al. Associative white matter connecting the dorsal and ventral posterior human cortex. Brain Struct Funct 224(8):2631-2660 (2019).

failure_modes.message: ERROR: classification/classification.mat is missing or empty
failure_modes.fix: Check the log of the segmentation step; the FreeSurfer directory must contain aparc.a2009s+aseg and match the tractogram space.
